Verify that a compressed snapshot's expanded data matches the current
live objects in the system. This validates that the snapshot accurately
captured the system state.

  Verify snapshot against live objects
  zqk system snapshot-verify test-scenarios/my-snapshot/snapshot.csnap
  Verify with detailed comparison
  zqk system snapshot-verify snapshot.csnap --verbose
  Verify specific fields only
  zqk system snapshot-verify snapshot.csnap --fields id,kind,status

Usage:
  zqk system snapshot-verify [flags] <csnap-file>

Flags:
      --fields strings    Specific fields to compare (default: all fields)
      --max-objects int   Maximum number of objects to verify (0 = all) (default 10)
      --strict            Fail on any mismatch (default: report all mismatches)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
